purpose: Test whether the non-vacuous P5B public-API recipe imports, constructs, preserves hint state, and executes a synthetic in-process data path in the official cedar checkout.
claim_boundary: Runtime public-API and optimizer-disabled data-path compatibility only. This protocol does not test cedar optimizer constraint consumption, plan quality, safety, or performance.
failure_history: Main Python 3.12 environment lacked tensorflow, ray, and torchdata.
The first isolated import failed because Ray 2.7.0 still imports pkg_resources, which setuptools 83 removed; setuptools was pinned to 70.3.0.
The next import failed because cedar imports PIL and Pympler at module load; the compatible torchvision/torchdata stack and Pympler were then installed.
The first object-state probe incorrectly assumed a get_tag method; the official object exposes public tag data as the tag attribute. No cedar source was patched.
